---
title: "DB Schema"
subtitle: A proposed database design based on MUDAB Data
---

```{css, echo=FALSE}
th {
  white-space: nowrap;
}
```

The page shows the database schema diagram along with table definitions based on the MUDAB dataset.

## DB Schema Diagram
The proposed database design shown in the ER (Entity Relationship) diagram below contains nine tables including three meta (entity) tables, five variable (look-up or reference) tables, and one fact (measurement) table.

The columns with `PK` in the diagram indicate primary keys of the table, which guarantees unique identifications.

![](./image/mudab_db.webp){.zoomable}

## code_lookup

Vocabulary reference table mapping category codes and individual codes to their human-readable names.

```{r}
library(tibble)

tibble(
  Name        = c("category_code", "code_type", "code", "code_name"),
  `Data Type` = c("TEXT", "TEXT", "TEXT", "TEXT"),
  PK          = c("✓", "", "✓", ""),
  FK          = c("", "", "", ""),
  `NA Allowed`= c(FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE),
  Description = c(
    "Primary Key. Category code identifying the vocabulary domain (e.g. ICESCL_MATRIX).",
    "Human-readable name of the category.",
    "Primary Key. Individual code value within the category.",
    "Human-readable name or description of the individual code."
  ),
  `Look Up`   = c("", "", "", "")
)
```

## station

Sampling station metadata including location, responsible institute, and classification.

```{r}
tibble(
  Name        = c("station_no", "station_name", "station_id",
                  "responsible_institute", "region", "institute",
                  "latitude", "longitude", "organisation",
                  "project_affiliation", "station_type", "water_body_category"),
  `Data Type` = c("INTEGER", "TEXT", "INTEGER",
                  "TEXT", "TEXT", "TEXT",
                  "REAL", "REAL", "TEXT",
                  "TEXT", "TEXT", "TEXT"),
  PK          = c("✓", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", ""),
  FK          = c("", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", ""),
  `NA Allowed`= c(FALSE, FALSE, FALSE,
                  TRUE, TRUE, TRUE,
                  TRUE, TRUE, TRUE,
                  TRUE, TRUE, TRUE),
  Description = c(
    "Primary Key. Auto-generated surrogate key for the station.",
    "Station identifier name or code.",
    "Original station identifier from the source database.",
    "Institute responsible for the station.",
    "Sea region (e.g. North Sea, Baltic Sea).",
    "Institute code for the measuring laboratory.",
    "Latitude coordinate (decimal degrees).",
    "Longitude coordinate (decimal degrees).",
    "Organisation type (e.g. NATIONAL, OSPAR, HELCOM).",
    "Monitoring programme affiliation (e.g. BLMP+).",
    "Station type classification.",
    "Water body category code."
  ),
  `Look Up`   = c("", "", "", "code_lookup (MUDABCL_INSTITUTE)", "", "code_lookup (MUDABCL_INSTITUTE)", "", "", "code_lookup (MUDABCL_ORGANISATION)", "", "code_lookup (MUDABCL_STATIONTYPE)", "code_lookup (ICESCL_MSTAT)")
)
```

## parameter

Chemical or physical parameters measured in the sediment.

```{r}
tibble(
  Name        = c("parameter", "parameter_name", "parameter_group", "cas_number", "lawa_code"),
  `Data Type` = c("TEXT", "TEXT", "TEXT", "TEXT", "REAL"),
  PK          = c("✓", "", "", "", ""),
  FK          = c("", "", "", "", ""),
  `NA Allowed`= c(FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE),
  Description = c(
    "Primary Key. ICES parameter code (e.g. HG, CD, ZN).",
    "Full name of the parameter (e.g. mercury, cadmium).",
    "Parameter group code (e.g. I-MET for metals and metalloids).",
    "Chemical Abstracts Service registry number.",
    "German LAWA parameter identifier code."
  ),
  `Look Up`   = c("code_lookup (ICESCL_PARAM)", "", "code_lookup (ICESCL_PARAMGROUP)", "", "")
)
```

## measurement_time

Date and time information for each measurement event.

```{r}
tibble(
  Name        = c("measurement_time_id", "year", "measurement_date", "measurement_time"),
  `Data Type` = c("INTEGER", "REAL", "TEXT", "TEXT"),
  PK          = c("✓", "", "", ""),
  FK          = c("", "", "", ""),
  `NA Allowed`= c(FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE),
  Description = c(
    "Primary Key. Auto-generated surrogate key.",
    "Year of measurement.",
    "Full date of measurement (ISO format: YYYY-MM-DD).",
    "Time of measurement (HH:MM). Stored as text; 00:00 indicates time not recorded."
  ),
  `Look Up`   = c("", "", "", "")
)
```

## analysis_method

Laboratory analysis methods used for each measurement, including chemical and physical treatments.

```{r}
tibble(
  Name        = c("analysis_method_id", "measurement_method_code",
                  "chemical_treatment", "physical_treatment",
                  "measurement_basis", "accreditation",
                  "analytical_laboratory", "control_chart_type",
                  "discipline", "proficiency_testing"),
  `Data Type` = c("INTEGER", "TEXT", "TEXT", "TEXT",
                  "TEXT", "TEXT", "TEXT", "TEXT", "TEXT", "TEXT"),
  PK          = c("✓", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", ""),
  FK          = c("", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", ""),
  `NA Allowed`= c(FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE),
  Description = c(
    "Primary Key. Auto-generated surrogate key.",
    "Analytical measurement method code (e.g. AAS-CV, ICP-OES).",
    "Chemical treatment applied to the sample (e.g. HF-C, HNO).",
    "Physical pre-treatment applied to the sample (e.g. DFRZ = freeze-drying).",
    "Basis of measurement (e.g. D = dry weight).",
    "Accreditation status of the analytical laboratory.",
    "Code of the laboratory that performed the analysis.",
    "Type of control chart used for internal quality assurance.",
    "Measurement discipline (e.g. C = chemistry).",
    "Reference to proficiency testing participation."
  ),
  `Look Up`   = c("", "code_lookup (ICESCL_METOA)", "code_lookup (ICESCL_METCX)",
                  "code_lookup (ICESCL_METPT)", "code_lookup (ICESCL_BASIS)",
                  "", "code_lookup (ICESCL_RLABO)", "", "", "")
)
```

## reference_material

Reference material used for quality assurance during chemical analysis.

```{r}
tibble(
  Name        = c("reference_material_id", "parameter",
                  "reference_material_code", "reference_material_basis",
                  "reference_material_type", "reference_material_sd",
                  "reference_material_mean"),
  `Data Type` = c("INTEGER", "TEXT", "TEXT", "TEXT", "TEXT", "REAL", "REAL"),
  PK          = c("✓", "", "", "", "", "", ""),
  FK          = c("", "parameter (parameter)", "", "", "", "", ""),
  `NA Allowed`= c(FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE),
  Description = c(
    "Primary Key. Auto-generated surrogate key.",
    "Foreign Key. Parameter this reference material applies to.",
    "Identifier code for the reference material.",
    "Basis on which the reference material is characterised.",
    "Type of reference material.",
    "Certified standard deviation of the reference material.",
    "Certified mean value of the reference material."
  ),
  `Look Up`   = c("", "", "", "", "", "", "")
)
```

## survey

Survey and voyage metadata linking measurements to spatial and temporal context.

```{r}
tibble(
  Name        = c("survey_id", "monitoring_station_name", "measurement_depth",
                  "station_latitude", "station_longitude", "measurement_project",
                  "survey_start", "survey_end", "vessel_code", "platform_type",
                  "vessel_name", "dist_to_coast", "est_country", "country_code",
                  "municipality", "sea_name"),
  `Data Type` = c("INTEGER", "TEXT", "REAL", "REAL", "REAL", "TEXT",
                  "REAL", "REAL", "TEXT", "TEXT", "TEXT", "REAL",
                  "TEXT", "TEXT", "TEXT", "TEXT"),
  PK          = c("✓", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", ""),
  FK          = c("", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", ""),
  `NA Allowed`= c(FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE,
                  TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE,
                  TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE),
  Description = c(
    "Primary Key. Auto-generated surrogate key.",
    "Name or code of the monitoring station.",
    "Depth of measurement (m).",
    "Latitude of the monitoring station (decimal degrees).",
    "Longitude of the monitoring station (decimal degrees).",
    "Monitoring project name or code.",
    "Survey start date (integer format YYYYMMDD).",
    "Survey end date (integer format YYYYMMDD).",
    "Vessel identifier code.",
    "Type of sampling platform.",
    "Name of the sampling vessel.",
    "Distance from station to nearest coastline (km).",
    "Estimated country derived from station coordinates.",
    "ISO country code (e.g. DE).",
    "Municipality name.",
    "Name of the sea or ocean."
  ),
  `Look Up`   = c("", "", "", "", "", "", "", "",
                  "code_lookup (ICESCL_SHIPC)", "code_lookup (MUDABCL_PLATFORMTYPE)",
                  "", "", "", "", "", "")
)
```

## lod

Limits of detection and quantification per parameter measurement.

```{r}
tibble(
  Name        = c("lod_id", "parameter",
                  "internal_qa_detection_limit",
                  "internal_qa_quantification_limit",
                  "expanded_uncertainty_pct",
                  "uncertainty_method"),
  `Data Type` = c("INTEGER", "TEXT", "REAL", "REAL", "REAL", "TEXT"),
  PK          = c("✓", "", "", "", "", ""),
  FK          = c("", "parameter (parameter)", "", "", "", ""),
  `NA Allowed`= c(FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE),
  Description = c(
    "Primary Key. Auto-generated surrogate key.",
    "Foreign Key. Parameter this limit applies to.",
    "Internal quality assurance limit of detection value.",
    "Internal quality assurance limit of quantification value.",
    "Expanded measurement uncertainty expressed as a percentage.",
    "Method used to determine the measurement uncertainty."
  ),
  `Look Up`   = c("", "", "", "", "", "code_lookup (ICESCL_METCU)")
)
```

## sample

Physical sample metadata including sediment layer depth, matrix, and field observations.

```{r}
tibble(
  Name        = c("sample_no", "sample_id",
                  "layer_upper_boundary", "layer_lower_boundary",
                  "sampling_method", "flag",
                  "matrix", "sediment_composition",
                  "sediment_content", "sampled_area"),
  `Data Type` = c("INTEGER", "TEXT", "REAL", "REAL",
                  "TEXT", "TEXT", "TEXT", "TEXT", "TEXT", "REAL"),
  PK          = c("✓", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", ""),
  FK          = c("", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", ""),
  `NA Allowed`= c(FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE),
  Description = c(
    "Primary Key. Auto-generated surrogate key.",
    "Original sample identifier from the source database.",
    "Upper depth boundary of the sampled sediment layer (cm).",
    "Lower depth boundary of the sampled sediment layer (cm).",
    "Method used to collect the sample (e.g. BC = box corer, VV = Van Veen grab).",
    "Data quality flag.",
    "Sediment matrix fraction code (e.g. SED20, SED63, SED2000).",
    "Field description of the sediment composition (translated to English).",
    "Field description of the sediment content (translated to English).",
    "Area of the seafloor sampled (cm²). -9999 indicates not recorded."
  ),
  `Look Up`   = c("", "", "", "", "", "code_lookup (ICESCL_VFLAG)",
                  "code_lookup (ICESCL_MATRIX)", "", "", "")
)
```

## sediment

Measurement table storing the actual analytical results. Each row represents one parameter value from one sample at one station, linked to all relevant metadata tables via foreign keys.

```{r}
tibble(
  Name        = c("station_no", "measurement_time_id", "analysis_method_id",
                  "reference_material_id", "survey_id", "sample_no",
                  "lod_id", "sediment_no", "parameter",
                  "measurement_start", "measurement_end",
                  "measured_value", "unit",
                  "data_qualifier", "internal_qa_count", "recovery_rate"),
  `Data Type` = c("INTEGER", "INTEGER", "INTEGER",
                  "INTEGER", "INTEGER", "INTEGER",
                  "INTEGER", "INTEGER", "TEXT",
                  "REAL", "REAL",
                  "REAL", "TEXT",
                  "TEXT", "REAL", "REAL"),
  PK          = c("✓", "✓", "✓", "✓", "✓", "✓", "✓", "✓", "✓",
                  "", "", "", "", "", "", ""),
  FK          = c("station (station_no)",
                  "measurement_time (measurement_time_id)",
                  "analysis_method (analysis_method_id)",
                  "reference_material (reference_material_id)",
                  "survey (survey_id)",
                  "sample (sample_no)",
                  "lod (lod_id)",
                  "", "parameter (parameter)",
                  "", "", "", "", "", "", ""),
  `NA Allowed`= c(FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE,
                  TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE),
  Description = c(
    "Primary Key. Foreign Key to the station table.",
    "Primary Key. Foreign Key to the measurement_time table.",
    "Primary Key. Foreign Key to the analysis_method table.",
    "Primary Key. Foreign Key to the reference_material table.",
    "Primary Key. Foreign Key to the survey table.",
    "Primary Key. Foreign Key to the sample table.",
    "Primary Key. Foreign Key to the lod table.",
    "Primary Key. Sequential index for multiple sediment layers within a sample.",
    "Primary Key. Foreign Key to the parameter table.",
    "Start of the measurement period (integer format YYYYMMDD).",
    "End of the measurement period (integer format YYYYMMDD).",
    "Measured concentration or numerical result.",
    "Unit of measurement (e.g. mg/kg, g/kg).",
    "Data quality qualifier code.",
    "Number of measurements used for internal quality assurance.",
    "Analytical recovery rate (%)."
  ),
  `Look Up`   = c("", "", "", "", "", "", "", "",
                  "", "", "", "", "code_lookup (ICESCL_MUNIT)",
                  "code_lookup (ICESCL_QFLAG)", "", "")
)

```
